svg.title: Four integrals that appear in materials engineering
svg.desc: a: the displacement of an atom in molecular dynamics is the net area under its velocity curve. b: the mass lost to corrosion is the area under the measured corrosion rate. c: the mass flow rate in a tube adds the flow through thin rings of radius r. d: the energy needed to break a steel bar is the area under its stress-strain curve.

g.text:
x(t) − x(0) = ∫ v
x dt = net area
Δm = ∫ ṁ dt = area under the rate

g.inkscape:label: c — tube flow
g.text: ṁ = 2π ∫ ρ u(r) r dr = sum over thin rings

g.inkscape:label: d — toughness
g.text: Energy to break a steel bar
U T = ∫ σ dε = energy per unit volume
